title: How to Do Affiliate Marketing: A Beginner's Guide to Starting From Your Phone
summary: Learn how to do affiliate marketing as a beginner, from joining Amazon Associates to posting affiliate links on Pinterest, Instagram, and TikTok, all from your phone.
body_markdown:
## Platform Link Mechanics: Where Links Work on Pinterest, Instagram, and TikTok


Affiliate links work differently across social platforms. Check where a platform allows clickable destinations, whether your program permits that traffic source, and where your disclosure will appear. A phone is enough to publish, but link placement and account features can change. Confirm current platform and program rules before posting.


### Pinterest: Business Account Setup, Destination Links, and Pin SEO


On Pinterest, attach the affiliate URL as the Pin’s destination link. The image or video attracts attention; the destination sends visitors to the product or offer. Pinterest’s affiliate-link guidance identifies the destination link as the place for that URL. Use a clear Pin title and description that accurately describe the item, and choose search terms potential buyers might enter. A business account provides access to analytics for reviewing Pin activity.


Confirm the program allows Pinterest traffic and that the landing page matches the Pin’s promise. Avoid misleading claims or Pins that imply a different destination.


### Instagram: Bio Link Tools, Stories Link Stickers, and Caption Limits


Instagram captions are not a dependable place for a clickable affiliate URL. Direct viewers to a link in your bio, or add a link sticker to a Story when the feature is available on your account. A bio link page can organize several offers; label each destination clearly. For a single recommendation, a direct bio link reduces extra steps.


Name the item in your post or Story, explain its relevance, and direct viewers to the matching destination. Check the URL on your phone before publishing, especially after changing a bio link or replacing an offer.


### TikTok: Shop Affiliate Program, Product Showcase, and Link Placement in Videos and Lives


TikTok Shop affiliates promote eligible products through shopping features, such as product links associated with videos or a product showcase, when available to their account. The seller sets the commission on qualifying sales. Review current eligibility, product terms, and commission details in[TikTok Shop](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/tiktok-shop-affiliate-center-guide) before promoting an item. A regular affiliate URL is not interchangeable with a TikTok Shop product link, and options can vary by account and location.


In a video or live, make the product and recommendation clear, then use the shopping link or other permitted placement available in the publishing flow. Do not promise a commission or product result that the seller’s terms and your experience cannot support.

Pinterest Pin destination link Confirm the destination opens the intended page

### Where the FTC Disclosure Goes on Each Platform


The Federal Trade Commission says material connections, including commissions, should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously. Put the disclosure where people will see it with the endorsement: in the Pin description, near the Instagram recommendation or Story link, and within TikTok content promoting an affiliate product. A disclosure hidden among hashtags or only on a separate profile page may not connect clearly to the recommendation. Use plain wording such as “I earn a commission from qualifying purchases,” and follow each program’s additional disclosure requirements.
